items.title: 6.3.1.3 Machine Learning and AI in the Cloud

source_refs.note: Topic 6.3.1.3 as printed (PDF 160, printed 157). The heading prints 'AI' as 'Al'.

blocks.text: Cloud computing offers powerful tools for developing and running machine learning models and artificial intelligence applications.

Example: Google Cloud AI and AWS SageMaker provide cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models. These services make it easier for data scientists and developers to create AI solutions without needing extensive local computing resources.
